caption: The drawing depicts a single soft bag or pouch with a drawstring closure at the top. The main body of the bag is rectangular and features a floral pattern with predominately brown, olive, and beige tones, interspersed with red and purple accents. The opening of the bag is reinforced with a solid brown band through which the drawstring runs, and the string itself is of a similar brown color. The bag appears three-dimensional and slightly creased, indicating a soft and possibly fabric material. In the lower left corner of the image, there is a simple pencil outline or sketch of the same bag, showing only the basic shape and the drawstring extended outward, without any color or detail. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no other objects present in the drawing.
title: Carpet Bag
